     2	# WP-004: Narrow `Route.method` to `HttpMethod` Discriminated Union
     3	
     4	## Plan Context
     5	
     6	Complete the model-settings hardening series by narrowing the `Route.method` type from `string` to a discriminated union, decomposing `buildRoutes()` into domain sub-builders, adding dispatcher unit tests, eliminating OWASP A05 error surfacing, completing `@throws` JSDoc coverage, and cleaning up a manifest artifact.
     7	
     8	## Description
     9	
    10	Define an exported `HttpMethod` type alias (`'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'`) and narrow `Route.method` from `string` to `HttpMethod`, converting a runtime validation check into a compile-time guarantee.
    11	
    12	## Scope
    13	
    14	- `mcp-server/gui/server.ts` — `HttpMethod` type alias definition, `Route` interface `method` field type change, JSDoc update
    15	- `mcp-server/tests/gui/route-table.test.ts` — Import `HttpMethod`, update the valid-methods test comment to note defense-in-depth role
    16	
    17	## Deliverables
    18	
    19	- `HttpMethod` type alias exported from `server.ts`
    20	- `Route.method` typed as `HttpMethod` instead of `string`
    21	- `Route` interface JSDoc updated to reference `HttpMethod`
    22	- `route-table.test.ts` imports `HttpMethod` and notes its defense-in-depth role in the valid-methods test comment
    23	
    24	## Dependencies
    25	
    26	- None
    27	
    28	## Acceptance Criteria
    29	
    30	1. `export type HttpMethod = 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE'` exists in `server.ts` above the `Route` interface.
    31	2. `Route.method` is typed as `HttpMethod` (not `string`).
    32	3. All 52+ route entries in `buildRoutes()` compile without error under the narrowed type.
    33	4. `HttpMethod` is exported and importable by test files.
    34	5. `route-table.test.ts` imports `HttpMethod` and the valid-methods test comment notes it now serves as defense-in-depth alongside the compile-time guarantee.
    35	6. TypeScript compilation (`npm run build`) succeeds without errors.
    36	
    37	## Active Pipeline Stages
    38	
    39	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    40	
    41	## Estimated Complexity
    42	
    43	Low
    44	
    45	## Rationale
    46	
    47	A one-line type change eliminates an entire category of bugs at compile time — higher value than maintaining a runtime test alone. The union type is the lightest change, requires no import ceremony at each route site, and all 52+ routes already use string literals that satisfy the union.
    48	
    49	## Rejected Approaches
    50	
    51	- **Enum:** Requires `HttpMethod.GET` at every route site — import ceremony overhead with no benefit since all routes already use matching string literals.
    52	- **Const assertion:** Requires a separate const array plus `typeof` derivation — more ceremony for the same result as a union type alias.
    53	
    54	## Notes
    55	
    56	This WP must complete before WP-005 (sub-builder decomposition), since sub-builders must receive the narrowed `Route[]` type.
    57	
    58	## Code Observations
    59	
    60	Inspected `server.ts` L290–296: `Route.method` is currently `string`. All 52+ route entries in `buildRoutes()` (L463–L1078) already use uppercase string literals (`'GET'`, `'POST'`, `'PUT'`, `'PATCH'`, `'DELETE'`) — no routes use any other method string. `route-table.test.ts` L14–16: currently imports only `buildRoutes` from `server.js`; L53–61: the valid-methods test uses a hardcoded `Set(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'])` — this test will become defense-in-depth once the type narrowing is in place.
